Chibi Maeril is a pixel-art companion for the ChatGPT desktop app and Codex CLI.

Version 1.1.0 refreshes Maeril's four-frame greeting animation. Her raised right
arm now has a clean silhouette, with the stray hanging sleeve behind her removed.
The regenerated poses retain her pixel-art appearance and are reviewed at desktop
size on light and dark backgrounds. The other animation states and all sixteen
look directions are preserved from v1.0.1.

**[Read *Mercy and Wards* free →](https://monkandwitch.com/en/b1/)**

## Install

1. Download the attached desktop ZIP.
2. Extract it into `~/.codex/pets/`, or `$CODEX_HOME/pets/` when `CODEX_HOME` is set.
3. Open **Settings → Pets**, select **Refresh**, and choose **Chibi Maeril**.
4. Enter `/pet` to wake her.

The archive contains only the `chibi-maeril` runtime directory with its manifest
and validated desktop v2 sprite atlas. The attached `SHA256SUMS.txt` records the
ZIP checksum.

Her companion is [Chibi Rishi](https://github.com/monk-witch/pet-rishi).
